name: Z80Pack
description: Z80Pack is an emulator for emulating CP/M 1, CP/M 2, CP/M 3, and MP/M II on Linux. This is a command line Docker Container only. There is a built in Shell in a Box WebGUI that is a command line browser window. You can also execute bash in the Docker Container. Configuration: **/config** - this path is used to store the disk configurations and CP/M and MP/M startup scripts. To log into the WebUI: **User:** vintage **Password:** computer **Note:** You will have to use the command 'sudo ./cpm' to run the simulator with root privileges.
